table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	headerno  = dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
	headerinvno  = dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	salecatcode=dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	altersaleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	posted = dbo.saleledger.posted,
	saletype = (Select Name From SaleType Where saletypecode = Max(dbo.saleledger.saletypecode) ) ,
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	salesperson = (Select Name From Salesman SM Where SM.SalesmanCode = dbo.saleledger.SManCode) ,
	amount =  Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice),   
	gross= Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100),
	salesman = dbo.users.username ,
	totaldiscount= Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2) + dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,
	difference= Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice) - sum(Round(saledetail.rate,2) * saledetail.looseqty) ,
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	accountfor=dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	NetAmt = dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),
	CashReceived = ISNULL(dbo.saleledger.Amt, 0) + ISNULL(CashCharged, 0),
	CreditCardCharged = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode), 0),
	Remarks = dbo.saleledger.Remarks
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.posted, 
	dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	dbo.saleledger.Amt,
	dbo.saleledger.CashCharged,
	dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.saleledger.SManCode,
	dbo.users.username 
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	headerno  = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	headerinvno  = dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	salecatcode=dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	altersaleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	posted = dbo.saleledger.posted,
	saletype = (Select Name From SaleType Where saletypecode = Max(dbo.saleledger.saletypecode) ) ,
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	salesperson = (Select Name From Salesman SM Where SM.SalesmanCode = dbo.saleledger.SManCode) ,
	amount =  Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice),   
	gross= Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (Round(( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc),2)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100),
	salesman = dbo.users.username ,
	totaldiscount= Round(Sum (Round(( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2) + dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,
	difference= Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice) - sum(Round(sd.rate,2) * sd.looseqty) ,
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * sd.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	accountfor=dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	NetAmt = dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode),
	CashReceived = ISNULL(dbo.saleledger.Amt, 0) + ISNULL(CashCharged, 0),
	CreditCardCharged = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode), 0),
	Remarks = dbo.saleledger.Remarks
FROM dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,   
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users  
WHERE 
	( DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode ) and 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.posted, 
	dbo.saleledger.accountfor,
	dbo.saleledger.impactinventory,
	dbo.saleledger.Amt,
	dbo.saleledger.CashCharged,
	dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.saleledger.SManCode,
	dbo.users.username 
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode ASC,   
	dbo.saleledger.date ASC
table.sort: headerno A, headerinvno A, invcode A
